policies.policy_name: Administrator Role Required for Service Updates
policies.description: Only users with the Administrator role (admin) are permitted to invoke the update_service tool to modify Service records.
references: | **Administrator** (admin) | System Configuration & Integrity | Full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) access across all tables. |

policies.policy_name: Non‑Administrator Roles Prohibited from Service Updates
policies.description: Users in roles other than Administrator (e.g., Manager, Agent, Reporter) do not have permission to update Service records.
references: | **Manager** (manager) | Supervision, Escalation, Approvals | Full CRUD on operational tables (incident, problem, change, knowledge); READ access to all the tables. |

| **Agent** (agent) | Frontline Incident/Request fulfillment | **Full CRUD** on **Incidents, Service Requests, Tasks, Work Notes, CMDB, Change, Problem, and Knowledge**. READ access to all the tables. |

policies.policy_name: Service Update Must Include Mandatory Field service_id
policies.description: Every call to update_service must contain the mandatory field `service_id` identifying the service to be updated.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.

policies.policy_name: Service Update Must Include At Least One Additional Field
policies.description: In addition to the mandatory `service_id`, a request to update_service must supply at least one other updatable field (e.g., name, owned_by, status, etc.).
references: At least one field must be provided. Service name must be unique if provided.

policies.description: The `service_id` supplied to update_service must be verified (e.g., via a lookup) before performing the update; IDs must never be fabricated.
references: Never assume or fabricate IDs, responses, or outcomes — rely solely on verified API results.
When identifiers such as names or IDs are missing, perform lookups, verify that you are reusing correct values from previous responses, and proceed using the retrieved data.

policies.description: Only a single validated operation may be performed at a time; update_service must be called alone without bundling other actions.
references: Atomic Operations: Perform one validated operation at a time, except when using approved batch endpoints.
